shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. military launched a large-scale leak investigation after highly sensitive classified information about U.S. advanced weapons stockpiles was disclosed by the media, and dozens of people, including some top military officials, underwent polygraph tests this summer…

children: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. military launched a large-scale leak investigation after highly sensitive classified information about U.S. advanced weapons stockpiles was disclosed by the media, and dozens of people, including some top military officials, underwent polygraph tests this summer, including some officials from U.S. Central Command and other combatant command commanders.

title: U.S. Military Launches Leak Probe After Sensitive Weapons Stockpile Details Were Exposed
